supportedFacts: Sections 2/4 cover Tomas Morato from Scout Rallos to Don A. Roces and specify no motorized traversal/parking 06:00–10:00 on Sundays subject to Section 5.
Section 5 first applies to the first Sunday each month during the first year after IRR approval, then every other Sunday, with TWG assessment before full implementation.
Section 6 lists emergency, police and establishment-delivery exemptions; Section 9 requires signs/advisories.
limitations: Scanned PDF read using local Windows OCR, pages 4–7; OCR is fallible and does not provide legal approval.
IRR approval date, amendments, implementation phase, current signs and enforcement remain unestablished. Do not encode blanket all-Sunday closure.
